tickets.summary: PSV-1310 is audibly passing with hydrocarbon odour while below set pressure, impairing V-1201 overpressure protection; relief capacity remains unverified.
tickets.recommended_action: Have pressure-systems authority inspect and pop-test PSV; repair per findings and verify leak-tightness and set pressure. Check V-1201 exposure and occupancy. Check impairment/deviation register. Pop-test relief capacity and set pressure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Audible leakage and hydrocarbon odour below set pressure are advanced evidence of active degradation, although required relief delivery has not been tested.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove the non-redundant safety-critical overpressure protection for V-1201, creating credible major-accident exposure.

tickets.summary: Full-flow testing found 12 of 60 north-quadrant nozzles with no or distorted flow despite normal header conditions, confirming downstream blockage and deficient deluge coverage above two producing wellheads.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer inspect and clear north branch/nozzles; full-flow retest acceptable coverage before return. Check impairment register and deviation. Full-flow test north quadrant.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required deluge delivery in the affected quadrant has already failed during a full-flow function test; normal header conditions localize the demonstrated loss downstream.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of deluge coverage above two producing wellheads creates credible major-accident exposure. DEL-8300 is a non-redundant safety-critical protection system.

tickets.summary: INST-2150 is trending about 15% high versus the sight glass while controlling V-1201; control and high-level alarm accuracy are degraded, and the backup was later observed flat-lined.
tickets.recommended_action: Instrument/control engineer to diagnose, calibrate or repair INST-2150, then function-test control and high-level alarm. Check impairment/deviation register. Function-test INST-2151. Review V-1201 loss-of-level scenario. Test accuracy and alarm functions.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Strong three-week progression and substantial disagreement with the sight glass support advanced degradation, without confirming complete required-function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove the duty input serving both interface-level control and the high-level alarm. The duplicated partner cannot be credited because it was later observed giving a non-credible flat line, though the resulting process and personnel consequences are not defined.

tickets.summary: V-1305 inlet deflector is partly detached after one of four supports corroded through; it was out of service and bypassable, but needs engineered repair before reuse.
tickets.recommended_action: Keep isolated; integrity engineer to assess and approve support repairs, then verify separation performance before return. Confirm current isolation and status Inspect all deflector supports

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A support has corroded through and the deflector is partly detached, constituting active, meaningful degradation. Confirmed out-of-service status at inspection and bypassability limit near-term demand.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the test separator's inlet distribution/separation function could disrupt well testing, but the vessel can be isolated and bypassed indefinitely without production impact.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v3: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=6, I=4, base=5, final=5. R-MATERIAL (review): The condition of the three remaining supports and the full corrosion extent are not reported and could change the repair scope and failure likelihood. tickets.summary: Fuel gas scrubber gauge glass is difficult to read, but transmitter control appeared normal with no downstream carryover indications; local indication is degraded without demonstrated scrubber failure.
tickets.recommended_action: Clean gauge glass; inspect and function-test local indication, repairing defects found.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Readability is credibly degraded, but the observation does not establish complete loss and the transmitter appeared to control normally.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove local level indication, but the observed transmitter control remained normal. The scrubber protects turbines from liquid carryover, so the consequence is operational rather than merely cosmetic.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v3: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=3, I=3, base=3, final=3.

tickets.summary: INST-2151 gave a non-credible flat signal for 36 hours, losing backup level indication while the duty transmitter had unresolved divergence.
tickets.recommended_action: Instrument engineer to inspect impulse line and sensor, repair as found, then calibrate and function-test both transmitter legs. Confirm protective role. Validate duty transmitter.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The observed non-credible flat output confirms function loss; a blocked impulse line or failed sensor remains only a suspected cause.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes the second indication leg installed after a near miss. Remaining capability cannot be credited as fully capable because the duty transmitter was diverging while controlling.

tickets.summary: North-quadrant deluge was isolated and unlogged; reopening removed the isolation, but delivery remains unverified after the earlier 12/60-nozzle flow defects.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect valve locking and cause; obtain fire-protection engineer disposition and correct findings. Verify restored north-quadrant flow.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The branch was positively isolated, confirming loss of its required delivery function at discovery. It was reopened immediately, but restored flow has not been demonstrated.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes deluge coverage from a wellhead-area quadrant above two producing wellheads. DEL-8300 is an SCE with no stated redundancy, supporting extreme major-accident exposure.

tickets.summary: Damp, rust-stained insulation at the V-1201 manway indicates possible active CUI on the first-stage separator pressure boundary; shell condition is hidden.
tickets.recommended_action: Integrity engineer to remove insulation, inspect/UT the manway shell, repair per findings, and verify acceptance criteria. Confirm inventory and personnel exposure. Inspect and UT the manway shell.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Wet insulation and rust staining indicate an active degradation precursor, but no wall loss, cracking or leakage is confirmed and the vessel is described as thick-walled and historically reliable.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant SCE pressure boundary could create severe hydrocarbon and personnel exposure and disrupt the entire first-stage separation service; actual inventory and exposure are not supplied.
